summary.zh: 以《Heroes of History》为例，探讨中度免费游戏中的玩家价值与商业化设计。

sessions.title: You're the Controller: Creating Intuitive VR Handtracking Interactions
sessions.title_zh: 用双手作为控制器：直观的 VR 手部交互

summary.en: Repeated playtests inform gesture controls, staged tutorials, and progression that establishes mastery before introducing more complex interactions.
summary.zh: 通过持续测试改进手势操作、分阶段教学与进度设计，让玩家掌握基础动作后再接触更复杂的交互。

summary.en: This Steam-page session explores communicating a game's distinctive appeal beyond listing features.
summary.zh: 本场 Steam 商店页分享讨论如何超越功能罗列，传达游戏独特的吸引力。

sessions.title: Zenith: Diffusion Model-Driven Map Generation
sessions.title_zh: Zenith：用扩散模型生成地图

summary.en: Zenith combines procedural geometry and conditioned diffusion models to generate layered top-down maps while incorporating artist feedback.
summary.zh: Zenith 结合程序化几何处理与带条件控制的扩散模型生成分层俯视地图，并讨论如何将美术反馈纳入制作流程。
